description: Angular component for asset profile autocomplete with features like fetching profiles, editing, creating, and linking to details page.

classes.name: AssetProfileAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a control for selecting and managing asset profiles with autocomplete, editing, and creation features.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form control.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up profile filtering observable.

methods.name: selectDefaultAssetProfileIfNeeded
methods.description: Selects default profile if configured and none is selected.

methods.name: selectFirstAssetProfileIfNeeded
methods.description: Selects the first profile from the list if configured.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validity if dirty.

methods.name: onPanelClosed
methods.description: Handles closing of autocomplete panel, resets value if needed.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and emits change events.

methods.name: displayAssetProfileFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a profile.

methods.name: fetchAssetProfiles
methods.description: Fetches asset profiles matching search text.

methods.name: textIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if input text is non-empty.

methods.name: assetProfileEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key press for creating new profile.

methods.name: createAssetProfile
methods.description: Creates a new asset profile via dialog.

methods.name: editAssetProfile
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit current profile.

methods.name: openAssetProfileDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for adding or editing asset profile.
